jobs.title: Subscription Growth Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 3-5+ years of experience in subscription, growth, or monetization product roles for a B2C mobile app Proven ability to own and optimize subscription monetization (pricing, packaging, paywall placement, and upgrade flow) Experience fighting churn through retention playbooks (win-back flows and churn diagnostics)

jobs.title: Senior Flutter Developer (Animation Focus)
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of mobile development experience, including 3+ years shipping Flutter/Dart in production Expertise with BLoC/Cubit using flutter_bloc and HydratedBloc, including immutable state and BlocSelector (with buildWhen/listenWhen) Strong animation skills in Flutter (AnimationController, Tween/Curve, implicit and explicit animations) and custom rendering with CustomPainter/Canvas

jobs.title: Technical Artist (Frontend) - Flutter
jobs.description: Production-shipped animation work in Flutter with a portfolio or reel (required) Deep, hands-on fluency with Flutter/Dart animation APIs: AnimationController, Tween/Curve, CustomPainter/Canvas, Transform, implicit animations, and tickers Strong animation fundamentals: easing, timing, weight, and choreography

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. PMP certification required 3-5+ years of project or program management experience (ideally at a startup or fast-moving product company)
